text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after our whirlwind days
running through the Twinkle Series with
Fusaichi Pandora had settled down for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha~♡
It's got that classic hot spring town vibe, as always~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come on a hot spring trip with Fusaichi Pandora,
which we had previously won from a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's see! First, let's head to this diner!
They only serve 30 parties a day, so they close super fast~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And after that, I wanna go to the footbath over there! Plus, the street over on that side had lots of fun stuff to see~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you say before
that you once came here with your parents?"
choice_data_list: As expected, you really know your stuff since it's your second time.
As expected, you really know your stuff since it's your second time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's the third time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Blast-chan won travel vouchers. So,
I'm going together with Blast-chan,
Ai-chan, and Lala-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, okay?
I totally thought I had plans with you!
But then they said they were short one person, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan, Ai-chan! Look, look,
a face-in-the-hole cutout! I'll take a picture of youâ¡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Y-You're taking it of just me!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Touring all the hot springs together, eating ice cream, chatting late into the night at the inn... it was super fun...♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So seriously, right now, I know this place
almost as well as my own home, y'know?♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fusaichi Pandora ended up
showing me around today.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well? Isn't it delicious?
Totally insane, right~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Btw, this plate is waaaay too cute.
Aaah, gotta take a pic!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I'll take a pic of you too.
Actually, let's take one together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
L-L-Look, a face cutout standee~!
Isn't this super hilarious?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, stand over there!
I'll handle the onsen eggs. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Excuuuse me♡
Could you take a quick picture of us~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Soooo waaarm~!
Aahh, this is the absolute best~...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! The hem of your clothes is soaked!
Omg, haha, that's hilarious! Come on, get it together~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Jeez, anyway let's go sit over there! Wait, pics first! Let's take a selfie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And as they took plenty of photos for us,
time flowed gently along our journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, so piping hot.
That was simply the best♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—Gotta send a LANE.
"Waitin' by the entrance~" ...and done!
Might as well send a photo too~)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
............
Ehehe, great photo!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Like, maybe I took a few too many photos.
Even though I snapped a ton earlier, and even before that.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I feel like we took photos in a lot of the same spots...
What kind of pics did I take again~?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"......Huh? The ones from when I came with Mom and Dad,
they're literally all solo shots of me~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Ah, but come to think of it, that's true.)

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text: Pan-chan! Look, look, it's a face cutout standee! Let me take a picture of you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe♡ Peace!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Has she always been like that...? Ahaha...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, but during the trip with Ai-chan and the others,
I'm pretty sure I took quite a few pictures!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (......M-Mm-hmm! Wait, aren't almost all of these solo shots of Ai-chan!?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(This one too, and this... over here is Ai-chan too!
Oh no, I'm way too easy to read~!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, so what was today like again?
Today was—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (...Hm? Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
They're all two-shots...
There's nothing but two-shots here.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Why? Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I'll take a pic of you too.
Actually, let's take one together!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Subconsciously?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting out of the bath, I had a LANE message from Fusaichi Pandora.
She said she was waiting near the entrance, so I hurried over—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You scared me...! Um...
N-Nice bath? Good work with the bath?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Something seems subtly off...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What.
There's nothing. Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wha, I told you it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! I'm thirsty!
Buy me that fruit milk over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I buy two bottles of fruit milk as told
and hand one over to her.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh? You want some too?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given how things were going, I thought for sure they
wanted to take a photo together while having a drink,
but maybe I was mistaken...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Well... that might be true, but,
still, still...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, of course I'll take it! We're taking it together!
Let's do it! Like, isn't that a given?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've been walking beside them for three years!
It's totally normal to want to be in the photo next to them, isn't it?!
choice_data_list: ...What's been up with you for a while now?
...What's been the matter with you for a while now?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that...!
J-Just hurry up and take the picture!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, taking it now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. What's this?
...This photo is super good."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a bizarre moment there,
but at any rate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an
irreplaceable bond between myself
and Fusaichi Pandora...
